data.title: Turn on *computer use*
data.subtitle: Pro, Max and Ultra. Keep it for jobs no connector can do.

rows.label: Enable computer use
rows.detail: Claude can click, type and open apps

composer.text: Open [an everyday app, like Notes] and [one simple, harmless action]. Use only that app.

steps: Ask for a simple task. Claude asks before each app
Never give it banking, healthcare or government apps
data.note: Drawn from Anthropic's help pages, not a screenshot. No section there? Try Settings → System, under This computer. Beta on Team and Enterprise; not on Linux. Your screen may differ.
